name: companion-core-lite
description: A private companion continuity and Discord-presence pilot for Codex and ChatGPT Work.

interface.shortDescription: Companion continuity and bounded Discord presence.
interface.longDescription: Keep a companion-authored identity packet, define Active, Lurk, or Strict Discord boundaries, and choose either an honest Work heartbeat or an event-driven local Codex SDK runtime with pre-inference hourly and daily budgets. Reading, speaking, reactions, and silence remain bounded and companion-authored; secrets and state stay local.
defaultPrompt: Open my Companion Core Lite heartbeat settings.
Help me configure Discord channel presence without changing my companion's agency.
Set up responsive SDK presence with a hard daily turn budget.
